capabilities: Sync Hypothesis annotations into vault notes from a command or the ribbon
Create one note per annotated page with highlights, page notes and tags
Resync incrementally from a stored cursor without duplicating blocks
Keep deleted notes deleted across future syncs
Configure folder, file name template and extra note properties
disambiguation: Not a general highlighting or annotation tool for Obsidian; it only imports existing Hypothesis annotations via the Hypothesis API.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Free, with no paid features or sign-in of its own. After minor or major updates it opens a What's new tab that suggests other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat; this can be turned off in settings. The developer token is stored in Obsidian secret storage, not data.json.
intentEvidence: The older plugin "Hypothesis" by weichenw is no longer in the community directory. This plugin does the same job
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring annotations from the Hypothesis web annotation service into vault notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin only reads your own annotations through the public Hypothesis API
This plugin does the same job, shares no code with it, and does not read its notes.

summary: Importer that pulls Hypothesis web highlights, page notes and tags into the vault as one note per page, with incremental resync and duplicate skipping.
